# Token Metrics

Token Metrics provides an API offering real-time, AI-powered cryptocurrency data and insights for developers to build trading bots, dashboards, and portfolio tools.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/token-metrics/.

## Actions

- **Get Price** (read-only): Retrieve real-time price and market metrics for a given cryptocurrency.
- **Get Technical Indicators** (read-only): Retrieve technical indicators for a token.
- **Get Tokens** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of supported tokens with metadata.
- **Get Top Market Cap Tokens** (read-only): Retrieve a list of tokens ranked by market capitalization.
- **Get Trading Signals** (read-only): Retrieve entry and exit crypto trading signals.
